quest.title: Furious Mouth of the Spring
quest.description: You discover a furious lake. What happened here?
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x250, Primogem x30, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x2

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: ...Melusine!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Pahsiv? Where did you come from?

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Disappeared, Pahsiv.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright, sure, but get away from that vishap! It's dangerous!

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Good Paimon, Pahsiv! Danger, Melusine.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Pahsiv reaches out to stroke the vishap's head and the furious beast obediently lies down.\nIt opens its mouth, coughs up a glittering drop of water, then jumps back into the water.

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Key, key, Pahsiv!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Woah. The vishap gave you the key when you asked for it. That was unexpected...

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Blue thing, good thing, key, protect.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: By blue thing, you mean that vishap?

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Pahsiv!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Was it helping you look after the key? Are you and the vishap friends?

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Pahsiv!

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Purple thing, steal key... Blue thing, fainted...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: P—Purple thing? Who is that?

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: #Purple thing, bad thing! Blue thing, Paimon, {NICKNAME}, good thing!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Err... Okay. It all seems a bit odd, but it does seem like you're praising us.

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Purple thing, very bad, Erinnyes, very Melusine...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Still, Paimon's never met a Melusine as unique as you... We thought Melusine all lived in the Court of Fontaine or Merusea Village. How come you're here?

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Court of Fontaine? Merusea Village?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You seem confused. Haven't you heard of those places?

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Court of Fontaine, Melusine... Merusea Village, Melusine...

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Ah... Erinnyes, Pahsiv, home.

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Erinnyes, Pahsiv, protect!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, you're saying that this is your home? And that you're protecting it?

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Pahsiv!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But don't the Melusine live in Merusea Village?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yes, that's kinda strange. Are some Melusine born elsewhere? Paimon can't see any others here though.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Pahsiv, do you live here alone?

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Alone? Melusine. New Valet! Pahsiv!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: New... Valet? There's a valet? Who?

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: #New... Valet! Paimon, Paimon, {NICKNAME}, {NICKNAME}. New Valet, New Valet!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So who is New Valet, exactly?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Pahsiv... are you trying to say New Valet is called New Valet, like Paimon is called Paimon?

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Pahsiv!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah-ha! I was right. Paimon's always said that she's clever, hasn't she?

response.speaker: Pahsiv
response.text: New Valet, Pahsiv, knowledge, ka-pow.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Err... you mean that New Valet is helping you learn things?

response.speaker: Pahsiv
response.text: Pahsiv! Lots of. Language, wisdom... lots of.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Er, Paimon's not sure about the "lots of" bit...

response.speaker: Pahsiv
response.text: Pahsiv, New Valet, protect, ka-pow.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And he helps you protect this place?

response.speaker: Pahsiv
response.text: Melusine...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You help him protect this place?

response.speaker: Pahsiv
response.text: Pahsiv!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So that's it... But who is this New Valet? And why does he need you to help protect this place, anyway?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Some bad things have happened here, too. We saw the stone tablet and how someone had scratched out the inscription. And we saw lots of filth... Was it all because of the purple thing?

response.speaker: Pahsiv
response.text: Curious Paimon, Pahsiv! But time very not lots of.

response.speaker: Pahsiv
response.text: Key, key, key, square, west, ka-pow, ka-pow.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: We'll be as quick as we can!

response.speaker: Pahsiv
response.text: #Paimon, Pahsiv! {NICKNAME}, Pahsiv!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Pahsiv gives two happy jumps and then leaves in a bit of a hurry.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It looks like we really are pressed for time. But we've already got two keys, so let's press on and get the third!

dialogues.speaker: Motionless Vishap
dialogues.text: (A vishap is lying over there. Is it asleep or...)

talks.objective: Search for the "key" near the "Mouth of the Spring"

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Look out! There's a vishap by the altar! It seems to be sleeping, but we should be careful...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? How come... How come there's no key? Has the altar already been activated? Has someone already taken the key?

dialogues.speaker: Furious Roar
dialogues.text: Raargh!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh no! The vishap woke up. We'd better scoot!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The vishap by the altar shakes itself awake, its eyes full of anger and hate...\nYou swim for the shore as fast as you can, but it isn't giving up...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's carefully examined the altar... It seems to have been activated already. But nothing has changed nearby...

dialogues.speaker: Furious Roar
dialogues.text: Raargh!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh no! The vishap woke up. We'd better scoot!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The vishap by the altar shakes itself awake, its eyes full of anger and hate...\nYou swim for the shore as fast as you can, but it isn't giving up...

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: ...Melusine!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Pahsiv, what are you doing here? Get away from the vishap! It's dangerous!

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Good Paimon, Pahsiv! Danger, Melusine.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Pahsiv reaches out to stroke the vishap's head and the furious beast obediently lies down.\nIt opens its mouth, coughs up a glittering drop of water, then jumps back into the water.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's a key! The vishap had it in its mouth all the time! But how come it gave it up so willingly?

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Blue thing, good thing, key, protect.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: By blue thing, you mean that vishap?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Pahsiv, are you and the vishap friends? Was it helping you look after the key?

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Pahsiv!

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Purple thing, steal key... Blue thing, fainted...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: P—Purple thing? Who is that?

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: #Purple thing, bad thing... Blue thing, Paimon, {NICKNAME}, good thing!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Err... Okay. It all seems a bit odd, but it does seem like you're praising us.

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Purple thing, very bad, Erinnyes, very Melusine...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You're saying that... the purple thing is threatening the island? Well, at least we have the keys.

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: #Paimon, {NICKNAME}, Pahsiv! But...

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Key, key, key, square, west...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon knows. Don't worry, Pahsiv. We're going to the square in the west right now.

talks.objective: Clear the filth from the water

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why's there a Melusine here? Hey! Get away from that vishap! It's dangerous!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The newly appeared Melusine reaches out to stroke the vishap's head and the furious beast obediently lies down.\nIt opens its mouth, coughs up a glittering drop of water, then jumps back into the water.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? What was that?
Key.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Key? What key? Is this drop of water a key?
Pahsiv.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Err... The drop of water is Pahsiv?
Melusine.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh! What do you mean? Is the drop of water a Melusine? Paimon's getting dizzy. What on earth is this? Aren't you the Melusine here?
Pahsiv...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Err... You're a Pahsiv? Or is your name Pahsiv? Wait... No, don't answer. You'll just make Paimon dizzier...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Anyway, Paimon's decided to call you Pahsiv. Is that okay?

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv?
dialogues.text: Melusine...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}... What should we do? Paimon can't understand a thing she's saying. What is she trying to say?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You can understand what we're saying, can't you?

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv?
dialogues.text: Pahsiv...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: This drop of water is a key, right?

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv?
dialogues.text: Pahsiv.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You're not a human, are you?

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv?
dialogues.text: Pahsiv!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Er... Let's not be rude all of a sudden, shall we?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm not a human, am I?

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv?
dialogues.text: M—Melusine?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh! Wait! Paimon thinks she's starting to understand. "Pahsiv" is yes and "Melusine" is no. Could that be it?

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv?
dialogues.text: Pahsiv! Pahsiv!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So you're not called Pahsiv. Sorry, Paimon got your name wrong earlier.

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv?
dialogues.text: Pahsiv... likes...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You like the name?

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv?
dialogues.text: Pahsiv!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Wonderful! Then that's what Paimon will call you, hehe. This is {NICKNAME}. We're glad to meet you. And thanks for chasing that vishap off.

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Blue thing, good thing, key, protect.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: By blue thing, you mean that vishap?

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Pahsiv!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Was it helping you look after the key? Are you and the vishap friends?

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Pahsiv!

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Purple thing, steal key... Blue thing, fainted...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: P—Purple thing? Who is that?

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: #Purple thing, bad thing! Blue thing, Paimon, {NICKNAME}, good thing!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Err... Okay. It all seems a bit odd, but it does seem like you're praising us.

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Purple thing, lots bad, Erinnyes, Melusine...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Erinn-yes Melusine? Err... Erinn-no?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Something wrong with Erinnyes?

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Erinnyes, Melusine, now...

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Pahsiv, Erinnyes, protect...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, something bad is happening to Erinnyes, and you want to protect it?

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: #Paimon, {NICKNAME}, Erinnyes, ka-pow, ka-pow...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Er... So... you want us to wham-bam ka-pow Erinnyes a couple of times?

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Melusine!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You want us to help?

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Pahsiv!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, so she wants help from us. That's good. Paimon didn't know how we could punch Erinnyes, with it being a whole island and all...

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Ka-pow, ka-pow.

response.speaker: Pahsiv
response.text: Re... ward?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Oh come on, {NICKNAME}! Pahsiv can barely talk! She won't be able to find anyone else to help her, so we should just do it!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What do we need to do?

response.speaker: Pahsiv
response.text: Key, key, key, number.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And then? How many keys is that, now?

response.speaker: Pahsiv
response.text: Key! Key! Key!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Three keys?

response.speaker: Pahsiv
response.text: Pahsiv! Key, foggy path, south...

response.speaker: Pahsiv
response.text: Key, spring, north...

response.speaker: Pahsiv
response.text: Key, willow, east...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, that's what you mean... Let's make a note real quick... Three keys in total, one in the southern foggy road, one in the northern spring, and one in the eastern willows... Is Paimon right?

response.speaker: Pahsiv
response.text: Key, key, key, square, west.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And there are three keys in the square to the west?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Collect three keys and go to the square?

response.speaker: Pahsiv
response.text: #Paimon, Melusine! {NICKNAME}, Pahsiv!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Oh c'mon, Pahsiv, do you have to always make it sound like {NICKNAME} is cleverer than Paimon? We're clearly of more or less equal intellect!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyway, we've already got one key, so all we need to do is find the remaining two.

response.speaker: Pahsiv
response.text: Erinnyes, Melusine... Pahsiv, protect!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Relax. Paimon doesn't know what's happened, but we're going to help you protect Erinnyes for sure.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But if Paimon could add one small point, Pahsiv, Paimon would like to say that if you happen to see anything shiny, round, and unwanted, or some expensive-looking chest...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, it would be just wonderful if you could let us know!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Pahsiv scratches her head as she tries to understand, then gives two more happy jumps and leaves in a bit of a hurry.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Oh, she ran straight off. Guess she must have something really urgent to work on. {NICKNAME}, shall we go looking for those two keys now?

choices.text: What do we need to do?

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv?
dialogues.text: Pahsiv! Pahsiv!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Pahsiv gives two happy jumps and then leaves in a bit of a hurry.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Look out! There's a vishap by the altar! It seems to be sleeping, but we should be careful...
